question: Why did NYC yellow taxi trips drop on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 compared with the surrounding weeks?

hmem_recall.content: Investigation recorded-example-2-snow-saturday: Q='Did the snowfall on Saturday 21 Dec 2024 reduce NYC yellow taxi trips compared with the other Saturdays in December 2024, and why?' -> answered: Saturday 21 Dec 2024 taxi trips were essentially unchanged despite heavy snowfall (supported: H0, H1, H3, H5, H6)

Investigation recorded-example-3-mlk-fare: Q='Why did the average total amount per yellow taxi trip jump on Monday 20 Jan 2025 compared with the other Mondays in January 2025?' -> insufficient_evidence: Average fare jumped 36.5% on MLK Day, but root cause remains unclear (supported: H0, H1)
Lesson: avg_total_amount includes tip and surcharges; if analyzing base fare only, adjust the query to exclude those columns.
Lesson: Aggregate yellow_daily tables often omit location IDs; always check schema before attempting zone-mix analysis.

{"sql": "SELECT obs_date, prcp_mm, snow_mm, tmax_c, tmin_c, CASE WHEN dayofweek(obs_date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_name FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily WHERE obs_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') ORDER BY obs_date", "tables_used": ["whybot.nyc_weather_daily"], "note": "Weather data for 28 Nov 2024 and three preceding Thursdays to compare against the trip drop"}

{
  "sql": "SELECT trip_date,
       date_format(trip_date,'EEEE') AS weekday_name,
       trips,
       CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target_date
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE date_format(trip_date,'yyyy-MM') = '2024-11'
  AND date_format(trip_date,'EEEE') = 'Thursday'
ORDER BY trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Flags 2024-11-28 as target date; one row per Thursday in November 2024"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  trip_date,
  to_date(trip_date) AS trip_date_obj,
  CASE WHEN dayofweek(trip_date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_label,
  MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN avg_total_amount END) AS target_avg_total_amount,
  MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN avg_trip_distance END) AS target_avg_trip_distance,
  AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 5 THEN avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount,
  AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 5 THEN avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_trip_distance
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY trip_date
ORDER BY trip_date
LIMIT 100",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Uses conditional aggregation to compare 2024-11-28 Thursday against other Thursdays in Nov-Dec 2024. Avoids self-joining the view. Returns one row per date with target and baseline metrics."
}
